title: A Herat scribe completes the text of Mantiq al-tair
summary: The text of a Herat manuscript of Attar’s Mantiq al-tair was completed under Timurid patronage, with a colophon interpreted as dating to 1487.

citations.locator: Colophon paragraph, Herat production and later Safavid completion; compare folio captions
citations.note: Supports the linked claims within the stated date and attribution limits.

claims.text: The text of a Herat manuscript of Attar’s Mantiq al-tair was completed under Timurid patronage, with a colophon interpreted as dating to 1487.
The essay reads the colophon as 1487, while one associated caption says 1486. This discrepancy remains flagged; no day-level conversion is asserted.
Its illustration history continued later: Safavid additions around 1600 helped complete the book. The text’s date therefore cannot date every painted folio.

unresolvedIssues: One linked folio caption gives 1486 rather than the essay’s 1487 colophon interpretation.
review.corroboration: The essay’s colophon discussion was compared with its folio captions. Their 1486/1487 inconsistency remains unresolved; these are not independent sources.
